before: The legacy audit adds all six universal review groups to every row. It never asserted all 38 literal fields must be populated. This map prevents misusing its inventory as a universal work queue.

classes.CONDITIONAL: Required only when the documented endpoint/method/branch condition applies; unresolved applicability remains unresolved.
classes.DERIVED_OPTIONAL: Not separately collected when reproducibly derivable from the authoritative time basis.
classes.OPTIONAL: No default collection/blocker for the selected target; a known contradiction or declared material model use can reactivate it.
classes.REQUIRED_FACT: Underlying fact required; equivalent shared reviewed fact can supply it.
